evals.prompt: Define methodology, method, and process in 2-3 sentences and explain why the distinction matters for agent work.
expected_elements: Methodology is the governing philosophy or why
Method is a specific technique or how
Process is the ordered sequence or when
Explains that agents skip steps when they lack the underlying why
Connects the distinction to rigorous task planning or verification

evals.prompt: Explain the methodology-method-process stack and give one concrete example of each layer for a multi-step agent implementation.
expected_elements: Names all three layers
Gives a quality principle at methodology level
Gives a concrete method such as checklist, hypothesis, or V&V trace
Gives an ordered process with steps
Explains how the method and process serve the methodology

evals.prompt: Distinguish methodology from code-review, testing-strategy, agent-eval-design, guardrails, and best-practice with a mechanism-level reason for each boundary.
expected_elements: code-review owns concrete diff or PR review
testing-strategy owns behavior/test-level selection
agent-eval-design owns eval cases, rubrics, hard negatives, or graders
guardrails owns high-risk action blocking or escalation
best-practice owns broad final quality enforcement
methodology owns process principles, gates, and why the sequence exists

evals.prompt: A team says, 'We already have a checklist, so we have methodology.' Diagnose the misconception and correct it.
expected_elements: Says a checklist is a method or process artifact, not the methodology by itself
Asks what principle or failure mode the checklist is designed to prevent
Explains that generic checklists become cargo-cult process
Mentions calibrating checklist items to known failure modes
Connects to quality gates or evidence receipts

evals.prompt: Design a methodology-backed verification protocol for an agent changing a risky script. Include the governing principle, method, process, and hard gate.
expected_elements: Names a governing principle such as defect prevention, V&V, or hypothesis-before-action
Names at least one method such as preflight checklist, test receipt, or traceability
Defines an ordered process before implementation starts
Includes a binary hard gate with observable evidence
Separates methodology design from concrete code-review or test-strategy ownership
